what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5231 Sudanese refugees in Germany, 0.2% of all refugees from Sudan.
Chad hosts the most Sudanese refugees, followed by South Sudan, Libya and Ethiopia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 1997 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level in most of those years, with the RSF among the opponents since 2020.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between South Sudan and Sudan in 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 1362 refugees and fell to a low in 2013.
It then rose and is at its highest at the end of 2025; the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
